sources.title: Agent Payments Protocol AP2 official documentation
sources.limitations: Human-not-present card and x402 examples, authorization/mandates. No sample execution, signatures or payments.

sources.title: Visa Onchain Analytics: Agentic Payments
sources.limitations: Buyer and merchant wallets are unique addresses; organic volume adjustedUSD. Dynamic dashboard totals not retrieved. No independent repeat-customer/net-sales panel.

sources.title: Coinbase x402 launch documentation
sources.limitations: Protocol functionality not economic adoption measurement; no actual requests or funds transferred.

sources.title: Generative AI at Work, arXiv2304.11771
sources.limitations: Current abstract5172 support agents,15% productivity improvement. Staggered adoption, not described here as randomized trial. Whole methods not re-read.

sources.title: The Effects of Generative AI on High-Skilled Work, Management Science
sources.limitations: Three developer field experiments,4867 participants,26.08% completed-task increase(SE10.3%). No full paper replication.

sources.title: METR early2025 experienced developer randomized study
sources.limitations: 16experienced open-source developers,246tasks;19% slower in study setting. Not universal productivity effect.
sources.independence_note: METR series: same research organization; designs, samples and periods differ; do not count as three independent replications.

sources.title: METR developer productivity measurement update, Feb24 2026
sources.limitations: Selection and timing measurement problems; imprecise faster estimates cannot be treated as reliable causal industry effect.
sources.independence_note: METR series: same research organization; designs, samples and periods differ; do not count as three independent replications.

sources.title: METR AI usage survey, May11 2026
sources.limitations: 349technical workers Feb-Apr2026; self-reportedwork-value/speed. Different design from RCT, same organization, not independent replication.
sources.independence_note: METR series: same research organization; designs, samples and periods differ; do not count as three independent replications.
